---
title: System log
---

#### 🧭 Introduction

This card displays the events that Pythagoras has logged. Initially, the most recent are at the top of the data-grid. Reordering the rows can change this.
Many of the events are recorded against specific "loggers" e.g. _data_import_ - which signifies it was generated by a data-import card. The &lt;javascript&gt; logger records events generated within the browser.  
The event importance levels are:

 - DEBUG
 - INFO
 - WARNING
 - ERROR
 - CRITICAL

#### 🔄 Flip side

There is no flip-side

#### ⚙️ Settings

Use the Tour Guide button to learn about the settings of this card.

#### 🎯 Goals

 1. _Primary:_ Identify & Diagnose problems 
 1. _Secondary:_ To verify the logic flow of the analysis

***

This card does not require a data set. This card does not change any dataset. Any cards downstream of this card will receive the upstream version of the data.
